```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Pennington County'
    AND border_type = 'county'
    AND addr_state = 'South Dakota'
),
high_elevation_areas AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM region_geom))
    AND ST_Value(rast, 1) > 1000
),
buffered_high_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(rast::geography, 2700)::geometry AS geom
  FROM high_elevation_areas
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, true, buffered_high_elevation.geom) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us, buffered_high_elevation
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, buffered_high_elevation.geom)
),
attractions_in_buffer AS (
  SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  JOIN region_geom ON ST_Within(pois.geometry::geometry, region_geom.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.tourism = 'attraction'
    AND pois.addr_state = 'SD'
    AND pois.addr_city = 'Rapid City'
    AND pois.poi_name = 'Sitting Bull Crystal Caverns'
)
SELECT pois.poi_name
FROM attractions_in_buffer pois
WHERE ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geometry, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_high_elevation));
```
